t.zh: <wiki-ref to="tautology"></wiki-ref>在电路上是什么样子？接出这句话，看输出那一列。
t.en: What does a <wiki-ref to="tautology"></wiki-ref> look like as a circuit? Wire this sentence and watch the output column.

brief.zh: 接一块电路，算出「（若下雨，则地湿）或者（若地湿，则下雨）」在每一行的真值。
brief.en: Wire a board that works out the value of “(if it rains, the ground is wet) or (if the ground is wet, it rains)” on every row.

hint.zh: 这句话由哪几部分组成？
hint.en: What parts is the sentence made of?

brief.zh: 接一块电路，算出「（若下雨，则地湿）并且（下雨，并且地不湿）」在每一行的真值。
brief.en: Wire a board that works out the value of “(if it rains, the ground is wet) and (it rains and the ground is not wet)” on every row.

hint.zh: 它由两半用与门接成，右边一半本身也是一个「并且」。
hint.en: It is two halves joined by an And gate, and the right half is itself an “and”.

t.zh: 每一行都为假的话叫<wiki-ref to="contradiction"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: A sentence false on every row is a <wiki-ref to="contradiction"></wiki-ref>.
